notes.title: END OF ALPHA TESTING
notes.notes:
First and foremost, we would like to thank you so much for your support and help with making Paint Desk Simulator Alpha a smooth and fun process. Every tester is very much appreciated in making this game a much better experience for everyone. 

We are planning on closing the alpha tonight at 11:59 p.m. to gather some hype for the main game! By the time the beta release is out, we plan on having a tutorial, better NPC interaction, and even your own employees. As a two-person developing team, we very much appreciate your patience with us.

The second thing I want to mention is our Discord! This discord is full of community members who support the game development process and get the first alert for any announcements. This discord is a great way to get information, participate in a community, and even win some giveaways! We also have a roadmap in the discord to get an understanding of what is planned to be in the game on the beta launch, and even the main launch. [url=https://discord.gg/VaqKfsMfzJ]DISCORD LINK[/url]

Finally, I would like for you to participate in this survey to get an understanding of where you were in the game and some general audience questions. This survey is completely anonymous and voluntary! [url=https://forms.gle/Wc7UUJrQMEj9wYT78]PAINT DESK SIMULATOR SURVEY LINK[/url]

Once again, thank you for all your support during this alpha test. We are super excited to bring this game to life for you all to enjoy and play. We are so happy about the positive feedback we have received. Everyone has been so nice and understanding when it comes to the game. Thank you again, we couldn't ask for a better audience to have. Remember, all hail Radiant.

notes.title: Alpha Update 4
notes.notes:
[list]
[*] Due to inflation the price for selling paint and paint accessories has increased, resulting in a higher profit margin.
[*] Autosaving has now been implemented. The game now saves at the end of the day. We have plans to make autosaving happen over time, but we have not implemented that just yet. 
[/list]

notes.title: Hotfix
notes.notes:
[list]
[*] Fixed not being able to pour paint
[*] Added a true pause menu (everything stops)
[/list]

notes.title: Alpha Update 3
notes.notes:
[list]
[*] Added product for the player on day 1 (1 paint can, 1 of each tint can, and 2 stir sticks)
[*] Set store hours to close at 6pm (18:00)
[*] Fixed issue where an order will still appear when ending the day with a customer in the store
[*] [u]Hopefully[/u] fixed a few issues with Paintsville paint items not showing up when appropriate
[*] Moved a few items around in Paintsville
[*] New display added to Paintsville, has no use yet, but looks good!
[*] [strike]There seems to be a new easter egg[/strike]
[/list]

There is still a lot planned for the game! I am excited to show the final outcome. Alpha Test will be closing sometime in September to build some hype for the beta release on Steam hopefully! The beta release is planned for late September-early October, however, this is subject to change!


Join our Discord to report bugs, give ideas, and more! [url=https://discord.gg/VaqKfsMfzJ]Paint Desk Simulator Discord[/url]

notes.title: Alpha update 2
notes.notes:
[list]
[*] Added EULA - EULA has been added to the game and will prompt the player to agree on first launch.
[*] Paintsville implementation - The second map has been added to the alpha playtest! There is now something to look forward to when getting further into the game. There will be more updates to Paintsville, however, it is pretty barebones when it comes to upgrades, but there is more storage for paint, tint, and shelf items. 
[*] Remember to join our discord - https://discord.gg/VaqKfsMfzJ - Use this discord to report bugs, give suggestions, and be apart of our paint-slinging community! We have community events, live streams, and even some giveaways!
[/list]

notes.title: Alpha Update 1
notes.notes: Added a few user interface changes to the main menu, including spelling errors and navigation buttons. Overhauled the paint pouring to be more user-friendly and remove some issues that were ongoing with the pouring. Added some Q.O.L. changes, such as a customer timer and loan payoff being maxed out to your personal balance, not loan balance to make it easier to pay off with the slider. Potentially fixed some camera bugs (hopefully)

notes.title: ALPHA RELEASE!
notes.notes:
The alpha build has been released! We are excited to see your impressions of Paint Desk Simulator! We have worked hard on this game and we are far from finished. There is still much more to come! We are inviting you to playtest the game so we can fine-tune what we have so far to make the game better in the future! We have plenty of plans to make the game much more fun and progressive. We have plans to add more machines such as auto-tinters, manual tinters, paint-shakers, and even your very own employees! There is much more to come to PDS, we just need your help refining and even adding things to the game. We want your opinions, so please, in our discord, let us know, open a ticket, and give your suggestions. Any bugs you find let us know so we can fix them. We hope you enjoy the game so far. Here soon (a week or two) we will be sending out a survey to see your thoughts and opinions on the game. 

Thank you so much for your time and testing!
Enjoy the game and all hail Radiant.


~From The PDS Team, Will and Jake
